question_stem:
A small steel sphere is oscillating vertically on the end of a spring, as shown in Fig. 4.1.

{{figure:figure_4_1}}

The velocity $v$ of the sphere varies with displacement $x$ from its equilibrium position according to

$$v = \pm 9.7\sqrt{(11.6 - x^2)}$$

where $v$ is in $\text{cm s}^{-1}$ and $x$ is in $\text{cm}$.

parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.text: Calculate the frequency of the oscillations.

parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.text: Show that the amplitude of the oscillations is $3.4\text{ cm}$.

parts.label: (a)(iii)
parts.text: Calculate the maximum acceleration $a_0$ of the sphere.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
On Fig. 4.2, sketch the variation with $x$ of the acceleration $a$ of the sphere.

{{figure:figure_4_2}}

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Describe, without calculation, the interchange between the potential energy and the kinetic energy of the oscillations.
